thesis: The morning thesis holds: CROX dipped intraday to 154.46 but held the 153.92 swing low and recovered to 159.57 (last), above a rising SMA20 (157.14), staying inside the 153.9-164.2 post-earnings consolidation under the 164.24 high, with forward P/E 9.98, rising estimates and no earnings until 2027-02-11. XLY keeps holding up while tech leads the risk-off selloff, so this remains a non-tech post-earnings consolidator near its highs. The edge is modest: last price is slightly above the 156-159 entry zone, volume is fading (vol_ratio 0.72, partial session) and price is near the 164.67 analyst target, so the position stays small, entries should wait for the zone and partial profits are taken at 164.24 (about 0.8R from 159.57, about 1.5R from the zone midpoint 157.5). Stop moved from 152.5 to 153.4 and target from 176.0 to 174.6 to match the pre-close technical card (stop just under the 153.92 swing low; target = 10.32 range height added to 164.24); R/R at the last price is about 2.4.
invalidation: A daily close below 153.4, which breaks the 153.92 swing low and the post-earnings consolidation.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (QQQ ret_21 -10.4%, VIX 31.19 at 1y percentile 0.991) with beta 1.498 exposes CROX to broad liquidation
Resistance at 164.24 rejected on 11-13, 11-16 and 11-18 on fading volume (vol_ratio 0.72); breakout unconfirmed
Last price 159.57 is above the 156-159 entry zone; chasing worsens R/R
Little room to the 164.67 mean analyst target after a +33.5% 21-day run; post-gap drift may fade
Leverage: total debt about 1.66B vs cash about 0.16B; short interest 10.46% of float means sharp moves both ways
